[[Fendi's Chest]] will spawn after defeating [[Soul of Fendi Nin]] in the final level of the [[Shards of Orr]] dungeon. Each player in the party may open the chest and will receive one item from the drop list in normal mode (2 in hard mode). After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and the party will be transported outside the dungeon after three minutes.
